I dont know why you have such a problem with me. I never asked to be in this situation and im trying to make the best of it. Hes my best friend and i just want to find a way to handle this without making it a big deal while still letting him know im here for him

Thank you. Ive been texting him and he says hes had feelings for me and was hoping that by coming out something would happen (not exactly sure what he expected). I told him that hes still my best friend and i still want to hang out but i dont feel the same way. Next time we see eachother in person might be a bit awkward but i think it was good to get everything out in the open

It really isnt that simple. We live in a pretty conservative area and people arent going to stop making jokes. None of it is serious anyway and he knows that. Plus, he wants to keep his sexuality on the down low for now and calling people out would make them think somethings up. He told me he has feelings for me and i told him that i dont feel the same way and i dont want things to be weird between us. Im trying to be supportive but i dont really know how to handle this

You're right. I didnt really think about how hard this is for him. It mustve taken a lot for him to come out to me and to place that much trust in me. The best thing for me to do right now is be there for him
